ownerTypes.repo: The evidence is produced and reviewed inside this repository: models, sources, tests and tracked receipts.
ownerTypes.external: Closing the gate needs an event outside this repository (Neo N3 acceptance, hardfork activation, network deployment); this repository can only pin the resulting receipt.

boundaries.scope: The deployed bytes of the current profile have not been read back from a network. Local VM probes prove the built artifacts only on a local chain.
boundaries.evidence: A tracked receipt that deploys the digest-pinned native build, reads the deployed script and manifest bytes back from the network and binds them to the packaged NEF and manifest digests. Local VM probes and the packaging receipt do not establish it.

boundaries.scope: Acceptance of the SmartAccount specification by Neo is external to this repository.
boundaries.evidence: Recorded acceptance of the SmartAccount specification and parameter set (profileVersion 4, abiVersion 4) by the Neo N3 maintainers, with the accepted revision pinned here. Local tests cannot substitute for it.

boundaries.scope: Handwritten models are not source, bytecode or VM refinement. The native core's compiled behavior is covered by runtime tests and source pins, not by a proof.
boundaries.evidence: A reviewed refinement from the formal/coq models to the nccs-compiled bytecode and NeoVM execution of the native core. Until then the models are handwritten and the correspondence rests on runtime tests and source pins.

boundaries.scope: Bounded callback charge models do not prove complete fee estimation, execution limits, maximum roster cost or resource liveness of the native core.
boundaries.evidence: Formal fee and resource bounds for the complete operation path (fee estimation, execution limits, maximum roster cost) proved against the native implementation. The current models bound only selected callbacks.

boundaries.scope: No public network runs the native SmartAccount VM and storage semantics. The profile stays draft-unactivated.
boundaries.evidence: The Neo N3 hardfork that activates the native SmartAccount VM and storage semantics, with the activated height or protocol revision recorded here. The profile stays draft-unactivated until then.

boundaries.scope: Governed policy confirmation is implemented in the local candidate; full VM and callback correspondence of every governance callback path and its resource charging is not established.
boundaries.evidence: Proof or exhaustive VM evidence that every governance callback path and its resource charging in the native build corresponds to the modelled core configuration batches and callback ordering. See localGovernedPolicies.

boundaries.scope: The pinned governance module holds the message and spending rosters in its storage; correspondence between that storage and the modelled policy state and its ownership is not established.
boundaries.evidence: Proof or exhaustive VM evidence that the storage layout of the provider and digest authenticated rosters, maturity and review state in the pinned governance module corresponds to the modelled policy state and its ownership.

boundaries.scope: Governance action 6 (module code rebinding) has no native landing method; the governance module refuses the action.
boundaries.evidence: Either a specified and tested native landing method for governance action 6 (module code rebinding) with its authorization and delay path, or a recorded protocol decision that the action stays rejected. The governance module currently refuses the action as not deployed.

modelLimitations.scope: Domain and witness predicates are modeled; crypto verification and arbitrary plugins remain external assumptions.
Finite topology and lifecycle models do not establish arbitrary-plugin behavior or operational liveness.
Abstract account/epoch tuple separation assumes no future-generation writes. Concrete 0xA2 key encoding, exact native epoch reads and complete module use require source review and VM tests.

modelLimitationsNote: Limits of the models that are not gates of the native profile. Carried over unchanged from the v1 ledger; they do not close or open any gate above.
